quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. It is against the law to turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: White signs with red and black markings are traffic law signs. This sign tells drivers that right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns drivers that the road ahead becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Traffic law signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You may see this sign where traffic comes from the opposite direction.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that pedestrians cross here. Slow down and let people cross safely.

questions.question: This sign is a:
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign always means stop.

questions.question: This sign indicates that:

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on this hill.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a steep hill. Slow down and control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What message will be found on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this yellow pennant-shaped sign say?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs warn drivers that they cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic from the right will soon merge into your lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill. Slow down to avoid accidents and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes will soon join into one lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Go through carefully, but you don't always have to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk or at a point where you can see traffic clearly before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Sharp left and right turns ahead.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns of multiple curves ahead. Reduce your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate work zones. Stay alert for unexpected conditions. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end soon. Drivers in that lane need to merge with other lanes.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, what should you do?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until the crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and stop if they are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: How high the space is from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The tallest vehicle that is allowed in this state.
The widest vehicle that is allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: How high the space is from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It tells you the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet, 6 inches.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mean construction is ahead. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down and drive safely around these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is coming. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always use your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school zone or school crossing. Pay attention and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: White signs with red and black markings show traffic rules. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: When you see a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check only in the direction you are going, then go.
Let all vehicles that came before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before going.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop. Look all around for traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
You may go through with caution.
You must give the right-of-way to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red light. Stop completely and wait for a signal that allows you to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Slow down to 35 mph or less before the curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to 35 mph or less before the curve ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. These signs may show a speed recommendation that tells you how fast to go safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway. You are about to enter a road with traffic moving in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells you the rules you must follow. You must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic light colors from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?
questions.explanation: A diamond-shaped yellow sign warns you of possible danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of dangers in or near work areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign forbids right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let other traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: At this sign, you must slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross your path. Stop if needed before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on roads. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go until it is safe and you can pass through the intersection completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is on the back of slow-moving vehicles going under 25 mph, such as farm equipment, construction machinery, or horse-drawn wagons.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Keep your regular speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, and slow down. Be ready to stop and let any trains pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions coming up. This sign tells you a side road is crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers of a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions coming up. This sign warns that a stop sign is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign tells you to be ready to let traffic merge from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to areas where animals, people, and vehicles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Drive slowly and carefully in these conditions.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: Stop completely. Then go when it is safe.
Stop only if other traffic is coming.
Other vehicles are entering the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely. Then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop completely. Let all other traffic and pedestrians pass. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Parking reserved for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking reserved for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for people with disabilities. These spaces are for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disability placards.

questions.question: An orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always means:
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back. These include farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and horse-drawn carts.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns that road work is coming. In work zones, watch for temporary traffic control devices and stay alert.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is displayed on slow-moving vehicles.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crosswalk.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Road work or maintenance is happening.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road work or maintenance is happening.
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction, maintenance, survey, and utility work areas. They help drivers and pedestrians stay safe. Traffic fines may double in these areas.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round red sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions right ahead. This sign warns you that the road curves to the right.

questions.question: This symbol is used for:
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks solid orange during the day and hollow red at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are always stop signs. You must come to a complete stop, check for other traffic and pedestrians, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to stop or turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign ahead, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions right ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending and you need to move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: Signs with a red circle and line through a symbol mean that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They give important information about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of a divided roadway ahead.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right for road construction.
The road ahead turns at a sharp angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns at a sharp angle.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers. This sign tells you the road ahead will turn sharply. Slow down and be ready for a sudden change in direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers. This sign warns you that the road splits. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down for a curving road ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down because the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: This white sign means you cannot pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs are rules you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles for any reason.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane will end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the start of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the start of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: You see this sign for a railroad crossing with no signal. You should:

options.text: Keep going at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing without a signal, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be prepared to stop if you see or hear a train. Never try to beat a train across the tracks.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Must always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs tell drivers about services nearby. These include rest areas, food, gas, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Give extra space for drivers to merge safely.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Give extra space for drivers to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and move to another lane if you can. This gives merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed here.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows that a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: This sign is called a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: Triangular signs pointing downward mean yield. Slow down when you see this sign. Stop if needed. If you must stop, do so at a marked line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn of upcoming hazards. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black letters or symbols. This sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: A sharp turn to the right is ahead.
You must turn right in this lane.
You can turn right only on a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp turn to the right is ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs have a yellow-green background. They warn drivers about upcoming road conditions like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic is merging ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs show you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow posted speed limits in school areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves right and then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a left turn. It is illegal and unsafe to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange, yellow, or bright vests and use paddles or flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: The light is about to turn red.
The light is about to turn green.

questions.correctAnswerText: The light is about to turn red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns you the signal is changing to red. Slow down and stop before the intersection if safe. If you are already in the intersection, continue through it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many turns or curves

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to possible dangers. This sign warns you that the road will be slippery in wet conditions and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to possible dangers. This sign tells you to watch for people crossing the road.
